messages:
mel: Heads-up — Pricing slab revision (v2.1) rolling tomorrow 08:00 PT. This changes commit slab thresholds and the short-term POC discount rules. If you have active negotiations that rely on old slabs, file exceptions ASAP.

sam: Which bits should I worry about for the LifeHealth POC? They're asking for 40% off for 90 days.

mel: 40% needs deal-desk + finance signoff if it affects commit credit. If it's purely POC (no commit), prefer one-time credit (<$10k) — dealdesk form: https://intra/release/forms/deal-exception

nina-dealdesk: @sam Send ARR estimate, deal value, requested discount %, & expected start/end dates. We'll triage today. If requester wants commit credit, note the fallback slab under v2.1: slabs now at 250k / 500k / 1M ARR.

sam: Thanks — sending now.

jess-product: Note: no change to runtime SLOs. Dedicated commit bonus (extra 5% credit) is being removed in v2.1; plan accordingly when modeling economics for committed deals.

alex-finance: If you convert POC credits to committed revenue we need a start-of-commit month for rev rec. Also large one-offs >$50k require revenue ops review.

kavi-legal: Updated T&Cs for the new slab mapping are in the legal PR: https://git.redwood/legal/pr/439. For expedited deals include 'pricing appendix v2.1' in SOW.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled — pricing-push/v2.1 -> prod @ 2026-03-22 08:00 PT. Release notes: https://docs.redwood/pricing/v2.1

mel: If anyone has open RFPs or SOWs that reference old slabs, flag them and attach PDFs. We'll grandfather offers that were formally signed before deploy time; pipeline quotes that are only verbal will not be grandfathered. :warning:

sam: Got it. Looping in customer success to capture signed docs.

nina-dealdesk: We'll fast-track exceptions for strategic POCs. Tag deals with #priority and cc me.

jess-product: For product teams: if you need feature-based exceptions (e.g., trial extension), add a short note here with estimated token usage.

mel: Thanks all — I'll post the final FAQ after the morning sync. :thumbsup:
